scope: Gabriel freshwater consumption math and display rounding
evidence: User screenshot: Gabriel 3/7, 37.51570449074099 BBL/day, 1.6 BBL/hour, 2h7m57s/in, N/A/ft, 11ft11in, 480 BBL, 320 BBL headroom.
findings: Freshwater daily rate was interpolated without display rounding.
Freshwater snapshot has numeric minutes/foot but no legacy formatted flowRate string; time/foot incorrectly used that missing string.
For 40 BBL/foot, this rate implies 2h7m57s/in and 25h35m21s/ft. Projection consumes dailyBBL/BBLperFoot per day.
Independent floor-inch and nearest-whole-BBL display can show 11ft11in and 480 BBL for a level just under 12ft. Preserve established floor-inch convention.
At 12ft in 20ft tanks, 40 BBL/foot gives 320 BBL headroom and 160 BBL to the 8ft minimum.
changes: Round fresh-water daily display to one decimal; keep raw precision for hourly and forecast calculations.
Display freshwater time/foot from numeric flowRateMinutes; leave production-water string display unchanged.
Show unavailable instead of NaN, Infinity or negative consumption rates.

checks.jest: 142 suites / 1421 tests passed; runner reported lingering async handles after completion

limits: No live backend configuration or operational inventory was changed. Screenshot rate is a regression fixture, not a new measured consumption setting.
